lib/services/service-desk/intake-core.te.reason: pure (no DB): who may present terms, add a photo and sign (IN_SHOP before check-in, unsigned), approved texts only (owner rule: no signature without legally approved terms), images judged by their bytes, photo size / count, signature PNG bounds, all reasons reported together, determinism and no I/O; run on pull_request by service-desk-ci.yml

lib/services/service-desk/legal-approval.reason: pure (source scan): owner decision D25 item 6 — no product path under app/, lib/, features/ or components/ grants LEGALLY_APPROVED or records a legal approver (the database still permits it until the D25 schema proposal is approved); the detector is proven on positive and negative samples; run on pull_request by service-desk-ci.yml

lib/services/service-desk/intake-slip-ht.reason: pure (no DB): the 1.3b-B intake slip HTML — Hebrew RTL, every text escaped, nothing fetched (strict CSP, no script, no external URL), the signature only as a PNG data URL, the evidence (text versions + hashes, signature hash, intake digest, photo hashes) on the page; run on pull_request by service-desk-ci.yml

features/service-desk/intake-model.test..reason: pure (no DB): the 1.3b-C intake screen logic and the server allowed-actions (intakeAllowed) the screen offers — sections, the signing blocker (no signature without legally approved terms), history lines, photo downscale under the request cap, a drawn signature, every allowed combination; run on pull_request by service-desk-ci.yml
